new_libraries.name: AsyncConfigPortal
new_libraries.author: Peter Soos
new_libraries.sentence: Reusable modular web configuration portal for ESP32 and ESP8266.
new_libraries.paragraph: HTTP digest auth, a dynamic menu, a system Status page, and an Other page (OTA with firmware-marker validation, restart, backup, password change), plus a composition API (addPage / addJsonEndpoint / addPostHandler) for project-specific pages. Ships an optional, opt-in network-configuration module.

new_libraries.name: AsyncWiFiPortal
new_libraries.author: soosp
new_libraries.sentence: Reboot-into-portal Wi-Fi recovery captive portal for ESP32 and ESP8266.
new_libraries.paragraph: The device restarts into a setup access point, brings up a captive portal, and gets its radio onto a network. Presence-gated.

new_libraries.name: TecnovaIoT
new_libraries.author: Tecnova
new_libraries.sentence: Conecta un ESP32 a la plataforma IoT Tecnova (panel.ceetecnova.com) por MQTT sobre WebSocket seguro.
new_libraries.paragraph: Maneja WiFi, la obtencion de credenciales via el webhook del dispositivo, la validacion TLS del broker, la reconexion automatica ante cortes, y el mapeo de variables del panel por nombre -- publicar un sensor o reaccionar a un comando queda reducido a un par de llamadas (setValue/onCommand), sin tocar MQTT ni certificados a mano.
